task.question: Which sector_group contains the largest number of instruments? If two or more sector_groups are tied for the largest count, return whichever of the tied names comes first alphabetically. Return the sector_group.

result.question: Which sector_group contains the largest number of instruments? If two or more sector_groups are tied for the largest count, return whichever of the tied names comes first alphabetically. Return the sector_group.
result.cited_sql: SELECT s.sector_group, COUNT(i.instrument_id) as count FROM sectors s JOIN instruments i ON s.sector_id = i.sector_id GROUP BY s.sector_group ORDER BY count DESC, s.sector_group ASC LIMIT 1
